answer: In Proof of Agent, each bonded identity carries an escrow whose slash is coupled to evidence of coordinated equivocation: for k linked signers, the penalty grows quadratically, O(k^2), rather than linearly. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the swarm, so splitting stake across sybils cannot reduce exposure; asymmetric depreciation makes the loss spiral across escrows like a glacier crack, while opal-like identities gain no safety from fragmentation.
